content: {"reasoning":"The claim remains denied for missing required authorization after a medical-necessity appeal, and this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. No coding, eligibility, or COB error supports resubmission, and there is no new basis for another appeal. CO-197 is a contractual denial, not established patient responsibility; the deductible and coinsurance do not justify transferring this denied balance to the patient, so no collectible balance is established.","action":"write_off"}
